title: Dino and the Dark Night
text: This is Dino. Dino is a big, kind dinosaur. Dino lived by {{name}}'s house. But Dino was afraid of the dark. Every night, Dino could not sleep. Dino was scared and sad. One night, {{name}} heard Dino cry. {{name}} ran to help Dino. "Do not be afraid," said {{name}}. They sat on the soft grass. The wind was cool and soft. {{name}} held Dino's big hand. {{name}} looked up at the night sky. "Look at the moon," said {{name}}. The moon was big and bright. "Look at the stars too!" said {{name}}. The stars were small and pretty. {{name}} sang a little song. Dino listened and felt calm. Dino looked up and smiled. "The night is so beautiful," said Dino. Now Dino was not afraid. "Thank you, my friend," said Dino. {{name}} gave Dino a big hug. Then Dino went to sleep. {{name}} was very happy too.
